item.title: 'Death to America': Leftist Columbia University Group Responds to Strikes on Iran's Islamic Regime

item.title: Dem Sen. Kelly: Trump 'Did Not Go into This with Any Kind of Strategic Plan'

item.title: CENTCOM: Three U.S. Service Members Killed in Operation Epic Fury

item.title: Trump Provides Update on Operation Epic Fury: 'Combat Operations Continue'

item.title: U.S., Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar Condemn Iran's 'Reckless' Missile, Drone Attacks
